identity: A third primary-school worksheet in the same series as doc_a17df83313f0 and doc_a83273e31ee3 (both 100.0), this one on general science and the lunar calendar: 20 items, one per printed line, thirteen sahh/khata true-false and seven three-way choices.
law: MCQ BANK (section I): stem = ONE unit ending where the siblings begin (I2), every option its own unit (I3), internal wa inside a stem never cuts (I5). 149 real tokens / 67 units = 2.2 per unit, the same profile as the two sister worksheets. Note this series uses THREE options on its multiple-choice items, not four - the count is a per-document constant and I checked it holds on all seven.
reasoning: Two stems needed the 0h latest-well-formed test. @36-@39 tumidduna al-shams bi-l-daw WA - the stem ends on a dangling coordinating waw, with al-harara / al-buruda / al-taam as the three siblings; if I had pulled al-harara into the stem I would have been left with two options, which the documents own three-option constant forbids. @109-@112 yabda al-qamar hilalan WA-YANTAHI - the stem ends on a dangling finite verb this time (badran / muhaq / hilal are the choices), which is a new dialect of the I2 dangling stem: not a preposition or a copula but an unfinished predicate. @100-@104 has the counted noun stranded on the wrong side (adad shuhur al-sana al-qamariyya SHAHRAN, then 11 / 12 / 13) because the original printed a blank between al-qamariyya and shahran; the stem is still the whole frame and the bare numerals are the options. Everything else is mechanical: dangling jiha at @24, dangling shahr at @120, and eleven complete statements followed by sahh and khata as two separate units. I5 blocked three tempting cuts inside stems - al-naml WA al-nahl, al-taawun WA al-nizam, and tuskhin al-shams al-ma WA yusbih sakhinan - all bare coordination inside one statement.
